page.notes: The right margin carries the numerals I, II, III, IV, V and the headings "Theorema", "Error aliorum taxatur." and "Obiectio." Their exact vertical positions beside the text are approximate. The Greek word "ἀτυξία" is copied as it appears on the scan and may be a misprint for ἀταξία; it is marked for checking. "Tertia obiectio" at the foot is partly blurred and is read from the scan without a [?] mark. The printed numeral "V." in the margin sits beside the paragraph beginning "5, Deum". The inline numerals 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 are part of the text. Several spellings (e.g. "fiplum", "exiftimant", "fiunt") are copied as printed. The printer's "Q. 22.art.4." is copied as printed.
